source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the [Open Fire Codes](https://openfirecodes.com/) website and use the search bar
 to find relevant items in the fire codes.
3. Open up [Inspection Markdown Documenter and Validator](https://github.com/aschendel/inspection-markdown/blob/master/doc/Inspection%20Documenter%20and%20Validator%20v0.10.md) in another tab.
4. Highlight, right-click on the fire code citation, and paste the markdown link in the search box.
5. Go back to the inspection doc, and click on the link to see that it was properly linked.
6. Reduce the font size to fit as much of the fire code on screen as possible.

Repeat until done.

Then edit with the [Automatic Corrections Script](https://github.com/aschendel/inspection-markdown/blob/
